versions.subject: Merge PR #4975 from @Murphy0801 - Add new rules related to GTFOBins
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '/rsync'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -e '
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'sh 0<&2 1>&2'
        - 'sh 1>&2 0<&2'
selection_null:
    CommandLine|contains: '/dev/null'
condition: all of selection_*
